verdict.rationale: Parahelp's automations run Internal Agent tasks on a schedule or trigger (e.g., a GitHub PR merging), and guardrails let users define event-based rules like triggering Slack approval above a dollar threshold or auto-transferring enterprise tickets, with an Automations page for setup and templates. This directly matches rule-based, event-triggered automatic actions. Missing for 10: broader documentation of trigger types beyond schedule/webhook examples and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of reliability.
